caption: Three plugs every Technician meets — the PL-259 “UHF” plug (the standard at HF and VHF, but not watertight), the quarter-turn BNC, and the tiny screw-on SMA found on many handhelds — plus the four layers of coaxial cable: center conductor, dielectric, shield, and jacket. Amateur coax is 50 Ω (T9B02), and any outdoor connector should be carefully taped against the weather (T9B01).
spoken: pictograms of PL-259, BNC, and SMA connectors, plus a coaxial-cable cross-section labeling the center conductor, dielectric, shield, and jacket
